subject: Kickstarting the 21-day technical runway — MAP & slides draft
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Riley <john.riley@brightline.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@brightline.ai>
Date: 2025-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Kickstarting the 21-day technical runway — MAP & slides draft

Hi John / Priya,

Great to connect yesterday — following up with the initial mutual action plan (MAP) seed for the 21-day technical runway we discussed. I attached a draft Google Doc (21d-runway-map-draft.gdoc) and a lightweight Week 1 slide skeleton (week1-kickstart-slides.pptx) that outline:

- Week-by-week milestones and owners
- Critical tech acceptance criteria (dataflows, latency targets, model parity checks)
- Security evidence requests (SOC2, SSO/SCIM) — stubbed in security-checklist.pdf

If this looks like a sensible starting point, can we lock the kickoff for Thursday at 11am PST? That session would be a 30–45 minute alignment: short intro, ownership assignment, and demo target for the end of week 1.

Two quick asks for you before the call:
1) Confirm the primary technical contact who will own the integration tasks.
2) Share any non-negotiable compliance gates we should surface in Week 0.

I linked the draft here for easy co-editing: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A21d_Runway_DRAFT

Thanks — happy to iterate quickly.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 21d-runway-map-draft.gdoc (draft), week1-kickstart-slides.pptx (slides), security-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: John Riley <john.riley@brightline.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@brightline.ai>
Date: 2025-11-30T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickstarting the 21-day technical runway — MAP & slides draft

Thanks, Ava — this is helpful.

A couple of quick notes:
- We definitely want to see the SOC2 artifacts up front; can Brightline get the SOC2 Type II report or an equivalent attestation before Week 1?
- Curious if we can compress to a 14-day runway — our internal timeline is tight. Would you be comfortable tightening the acceptance gates and making some of the milestones parallel?

Also: I can own the integration coordination for the first two weeks; Priya will own SSO and security questions.

Thursday 11am PST works for us if that time stays available.

John
Director of Platform Engineering
Brightline Labs

On Nov 30, 2025, at 09:12 AM, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Great to connect yesterday — following up with the initial mutual action plan (MAP) seed for the 21-day technical runway we discussed....

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-11-30T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Internal — Brightline asked about compressing to 14 days (quick alignment)

Marissa / Ben,

Heads up — John accepted the plan but asked whether we can compress to a 14-day runway. Priya at Brightline will own SSO/security; John will coordinate integration.

My read: we can support an accelerated 14-day variant if we shift some milestones to run in parallel and defer lower-priority acceptance checks to a post-acceptance backlog. Specifically:
- Parallelize data ingestion validation + model runtime tuning during Week 1.
- Keep demo scope for Week 1 limited to inference parity on sample dataset (not full throughput).
- Move longer-term perf profiling and autoscaling to a Week 3 post-acceptance window (out of the critical path).

Can you both review the attached MAP draft and suggest which owners we should assign as 'critical' vs 'nice-to-have'? I can update the GDoc quickly after your notes.

Also tagging Ben for the Week 1 demo script — can you take a first pass on the slides?

Thanks —
Ava

Attachments: 21d-runway-map-draft.gdoc

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Riley <john.riley@brightline.ai>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@brightline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-12-01T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Updated MAP (accelerated path) + Week 1 slides — ready for kickoff

John / Priya — thanks for the quick replies and for confirming owners. I updated the MAP to include an "accelerated path" section that compresses the core acceptance milestones into 14 days while flagging lower-priority items for post-acceptance. Changes included:

- Compressed milestone timeline (see "Accelerated path" header in the GDoc)
- Clear Week 1 demo acceptance: inference parity on sample dataset, successful end-to-end pipeline with basic monitoring hooks
- Security checklist: requested SOC2 Type II and SSO/SCIM access timeline; we included a minimal set of required logs for initial validation

Updated doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A21d_Runway_DRAFT (now live with comments)
Updated slides (Week 1): attached (week1-kickstart-slides.pptx)
Security checklist attached as PDF for Priya's review.

Proposed agenda for Thursday 11am PST kickoff (30–45m):
- 0–10m: Introductions & success criteria
- 10–25m: Runthrough of accelerated MAP milestones and owners
- 25–35m: Week 1 demo target & slide walk-through (Ben)
- 35–45m: Blockers, SSO access, and next steps

If you confirm SOC2 material availability and the 11am time slot, I'll send a calendar invite and HubSpot update (deal BL-2025-1374).

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: week1-kickstart-slides.pptx, security-checklist.pdf
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BL-2025-1374

From: John Riley <john.riley@brightline.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@brightline.ai>
Date: 2025-12-02T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP (accelerated path) + Week 1 slides — ready for kickoff

Ava — thanks for the updates and for being flexible on timeline.

Confirming: Thurs 11am PST is good. Brightline will provide SOC2 Type II summary and our SSO admin (Priya) will share SCIM credentials during Week 0. We accept the accelerated 14-day path as the primary plan and will treat the longer perf work as post-acceptance.

Looking forward to the kickoff — I'll accept the invite once you send it.

Cheers,
John
